title: PROBABILITY, COMPUTING, AND SIMULATION IN STATISTICS
description: Review of probability, including univariate distributions and limit theorems. Random-number generation and simulation of statistical distributions. Bootstrap estimates of standard error. Variance reduction techniques. Emphasis on the use of computation in statistics using the MATLAB programming language.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: ST 422.
A minimum grade of D- is required in ST 422.
